title: 1-V Power Supply CMOS Cascode Amplifier
figure_number: Fig. 3. Bias circuit eliminating unknown BJT ’s.
function_summary: 1-V Power Supply CMOS Cascode Amplifier: In this paper, we design a folded cascode operational transconductance amplifier in a standard CMOS process, which has a measured 69-dB dc gain, a 2-MHz bandwidth, and compatible inputand output voltage levels at a 1-V power supply.
